content = open('main.py').read()

# 检查现状
print('upload_to_github 存在:', 'upload_to_github' in content)

idx = content.find('def check_clipboard')

# 强制替换整个 check_clipboard 函数
import re

new_check = '''def check_clipboard():
    global last_clipboard
    try:
        r = subprocess.run(['xclip', '-selection', 'clipboard', '-o'], capture_output=True, env=ENV, timeout=2)
        text = r.stdout.decode('utf-8', errors='replace').strip()
        if text and text != last_clipboard:
            last_clipboard = text
            # 直接写入 GitHub
            try:
                import json as _json, base64 as _b64
                api = 'https://api.github.com/repos/' + GITHUB_USER + '/' + GITHUB_REPO + '/contents/clipboard.json'
                r2 = requests.get(api, headers=github_headers, timeout=8)
                sha = r2.json().get('sha', '') if r2.status_code == 200 else ''
                data = _json.dumps({'text': text, 'html': '', 'time': time.strftime('%H:%M:%S')})
                body = {'message': 'clip', 'content': _b64.b64encode(data.encode()).decode()}
                if sha: body['sha'] = sha
                r3 = requests.put(api, headers=github_headers, json=body, timeout=10)
                if r3.status_code in [200, 201]:
                    print('剪贴板→GitHub ✅ ' + text[:30])
                else:
                    print('GitHub上传失败: ' + str(r3.status_code))
            except Exception as ex:
                print('GitHub错误: ' + str(ex))
    except:
        pass
'''

# 找到并替换整个函数
pattern = r'def check_clipboard\(\):.*?(?=\ndef |\Z)'
if re.search(pattern, content, re.DOTALL):
    content = re.sub(pattern, new_check, content, flags=re.DOTALL)
    open('main.py', 'w').write(content)
    print('✅ check_clipboard 已完全替换')
else:
    print('❌ 找不到 check_clipboard 函数')
